title: post api trips create new trip
description: Test creating a new trip with valid name, destination, and budget while authenticated; expect 200 response with the new trip data.

title: get api me trips list user trips
description: Test retrieving the list of trips for the signed-in user; expect 200 response with an array of trips when authenticated, and 401 when not authenticated.

title: get api trips tripid retrieve trip board
description: Test retrieving a public trip board by tripId; expect 200 with trip data for existing trip and 404 for unknown tripId.

title: post api trips tripid join trip
description: Test joining a trip as a member with valid session; expect 200 with { ok: true } and 401 if not authenticated.

title: delete api trips tripid delete trip
description: Test deleting a trip as the organizer; expect 200 with { ok: true } and 403 if not the organizer.

title: get api trips tripid listings list ranked homes
description: Test listing the trip's ranked homes publicly; expect 200 with Listing array for existing trip and 404 for missing trip.

title: post api trips tripid votes cast or change vote
description: Test casting or changing a vote on a listing while authenticated; expect 200 with { ok: true } and 401 if not authenticated.

title: post api trips tripid submit submit home url
description: Test submitting a home URL to the board while authenticated; expect 200 with created Submission and 401 if not authenticated.

title: post api trips tripid caveats submit criterion
description: Test submitting a must-have criterion request while authenticated; expect 200 with pending Caveat and 401 if not authenticated.

title: post api trips tripid refresh trigger listing search
description: Test triggering a fresh listing search as the organizer; expect 200 with { ok: true }, 403 if not organizer, and 429 if rate limited.
